input_fields.name: located_defect
input_fields.description: One open edge, invalid face, nonmanifold junction, or localized defect identity.

input_fields.name: selected_repair_method
input_fields.description: One preselected target-version repair mode and known call/signature if available.

input_fields.name: allowable_scope
input_fields.description: Faces/edges/body region and dimensions that may not change.

result_fields.name: single_defect_repair
result_fields.description: One mode, target selector, exact call fragment, or needs_manual_review.

result_fields.name: resulting_condition
result_fields.description: One closure/validity condition to check afterward.

result_fields.name: preservation_checks
result_fields.description: Dimensions/topology constraints that must remain unchanged.

procedure: Verify defect identity and choose one local mode: close one gap, heal one face, or replace one edge only when its call is known.
Construct mode-specific selector/call; do not emit generic repair-all.
State one closure/validity condition and preservation checks.
If defect, mode, or API is unproven, set needs_manual_review=true and emit no guessed call.
rejection_rules: Reject multiple defects, unbounded region, unknown mode/signature, or dimension-changing repair.
Do not claim closure/validity until a separate geometry check.
